🔥🇲🇽 <u>59 HOMEMADE EXPLOSIVES SEIZED ON BUS HEADED TO CNTE TEACHERS' MARCH</u>

Authorities just intercepted a bus on the Mexico-Cuernavaca highway carrying 59 homemade explosive devices — and the bus was on its way to join today's CNTE teachers' march in CDMX. Inspection happened peacefully with passenger consent after a citizen tip, coordinated with CNDH and the CDMX government.

Arturo Medina, Segob Undersecretary of Human Rights: "Estamos a favor de la manifestación pacífica, pero no se debe poner en riesgo a la población."

Read it slowly: bombs. On a bus. Disguised inside a teachers' protest. Eleven days before Mexico hosts the World Cup. Sheinbaum has been saying for a week the provocation isn't coming from the teachers — it's coming from groups who NEED a repression headline before the international cameras land. There's the smoking gun.

Source: Contralínea

🇲🇽🇨🇺 <u>UN HUMAN RIGHTS CHIEF DEMANDS US LIFT CUBA SANCTIONS — INFANT MORTALITY HAS DOUBLED</u>

UN High Commissioner Volker Türk publicly broke from Washington today and demanded the US immediately lift the sanctions Trump tightened on Cuba since January 2026, citing collapse of essential services and child deaths.

The numbers Türk put on the record: infant mortality on the island has DOUBLED to 9.9 deaths per 1,000 births. Childhood cancer survival has crashed from 85% to 65%. Blackouts exceed 20 hours a day. Oncology, dialysis, maternal health all gasping.

Türk: "There are children dying because doctors do not have access to essential medical supplies and medicines. This is unacceptable."

Mexico has been the only neighbor on the right side — Sembrando Vida still in Cuba, fuel and humanitarian aid still flowing. The blockade is policy-murder of children. The UN just said it.

Source: La Jornada / Infobae

🚨🇲🇽 <u>DHS BLOWS UP TRUMP-ADMIN NARRATIVE: NO "SPECIAL PERMITS" FOR DURAZO OR VILLARREAL</u>

The US Department of Homeland Security confirmed in writing to La Opinión that Sonora governor Alfonso Durazo and Tamaulipas governor Américo Villarreal have NOT been granted any "parole for significant public benefit" — directly contradicting the LA Times story Trump's circle planted in January claiming both had visas revoked but secret permits to keep flying in.

DHS reply: "Francisco Alfonso Durazo Montaño and Américo Villarreal Anaya have not been [benefited with such permission]."

Sheinbaum nailed it from Palacio Nacional: the leaks are "narratives pushed by sectors seeking to affect the bilateral relationship between Mexico and the United States." Translation: the soft-coup playbook keeps recycling. The paper said it. DHS killed it.

Source: La Jornada
📸 Presentación de Olinia — Zumpango, Estado de México · 7 de junio de 2026

🇲🇽✊ "When Mexico trusts in the intelligence and creativity of its people, there is no limit that can stop it." "Olinia is the hope of a Mexico that recognizes in its youth the strength of its present and its future. Because when Mexico trusts in the intelligence and creativity of its people, there is no limit that can stop it." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, presenting Olinia in Zumpango, June 7 Manufacturing target: 10,000 units in 2027. First deliveries summer 2027. Designed by young Mexican engineers over 18 months. The 4T's industrial doctrine in one prototype.

🇲🇽🎨 "Knowledge is one of the greatest riches of a nation." "Olinia is the vision of a country that understands that knowledge is one of the greatest riches of a nation." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, presenting Olinia in Zumpango, June 7 The maquila doctrine assigned Mexico the role of cheap labor importing foreign technology. Plan México inverts that — Mexican engineering, Mexican design, Mexican manufacturing. Olinia is the prototype of that inversion.

🇲🇽🏭 "Mexico was not made only for the maquila." "For a long time they spoke of Mexico as a country destined only to produce what others imagined. They told us 'we can't,' 'we shouldn't.' That innovation was reserved for other places. That Mexico was made only for the maquila. That our role was to receive technology, not develop it. To receive ideas, not create them. That is false." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, presenting Olinia in Zumpango, June 7 Olinia: Mexico's first domestically-designed electric vehicle. 150,000 pesos, 125 km range, 50% Mexican content rising to 75% by 2030. Designed in 18 months by young Mexican engineers.
